consequence.statement: On nodes with Linux kernel 6.6 or newer, Cilium attaches its tc BPF programs in the core datapath using tcx BPF links instead of old-style tc BPF attachment; setups with third-party old-style tc BPF users should disable this via the Helm value bpf.enableTCX=false in order to continue in old-style tc BPF attachment mode as before.
consequence.remediation: Set the Helm value bpf.enableTCX=false to continue in old-style tc BPF attachment mode when third-party old-style tc BPF users are present.

assertion.statement: For Linux kernels 6.6 or newer, Cilium 1.16 by default attaches its tc BPF programs in the core datapath using tcx BPF links instead of old-style tc BPF attachment, controlled by the Helm value bpf.enableTCX, which should be set to false when third-party old-style tc BPF users are present.
